title: Post-it Notes Came From a Failed Glue
description:
Post-it Notes started with a failed glue: a 3M scientist made a weak, re-stickable adhesive by mistake in 1968.
Follow MarketOpsTips for the stories behind big brands.

#business #postit #shorts

beats.say: Post-it Notes exist because a glue failed.
In 1968, 3M scientist Spencer Silver was trying to make a strong adhesive.
Instead, he made a weak one that could stick, peel off, and stick again.
His colleague Art Fry found a use for it.
He used it to stick bookmarks in his choir book.
Post-it Notes finally reached stores in 1980.
So, what failed idea of yours could be the next big thing?
